V3E-001.claim: The vendored aggregate runner ignored adopter layer declarations, producing false findings and silently narrower scans.
V3E-001.reproduction: Compare mapped-layer per-check invocation with the aggregate checks command over the same standalone repository.

V3E-002.claim: The transitive foreign-import ban conflicted with repository-local shell wiring of a real adapter.
V3E-002.reproduction: Forbid indirect foreign imports from the shell and then import the owning real adapter at the local wiring root.

V3E-003.claim: The fixed exception-code grammar rejected hyphens already published by a component contract.
V3E-003.reproduction: Run the exception-code check against a namespaced leaf such as consink.render.terminal-lost.

V3E-004.claim: A wildcard-ending inline code span could abort Doxygen parsing while the documentation-style proxy accepted it.
V3E-004.reproduction: Render a documentation block containing a backtick-delimited package wildcard with Doxygen 1.10.0.

V3E-005.claim: mutmut 3.3.1 imports the Unix-only resource module before argument parsing and cannot produce a Windows verdict.
V3E-005.reproduction: Import or invoke mutmut 3.3.1 on Windows.

V3E-006.claim: sim-scheduler's documented bare mypy invocation had no target and exited 2 while explicit repository roots passed.
V3E-006.reproduction: Run python -m mypy, then python -m mypy src tests tools, from the named standalone commit.

V3E-007.claim: Windows loopback buffering did not deterministically provoke wire-level backpressure while injection at the owned socket seam did.
V3E-007.reproduction: Attempt to saturate a stalled Windows loopback consumer, then inject TimeoutError at the adapter socket seam.

V3E-008.claim: Universal comment-presence and physical real/fake/faulty shape rules multiplied ceremony without establishing semantic discrimination.
observed_in: four v3.2 component adoptions summarized in the v4 roadmap
